title: Add new output socket to nodes Recraft V4 Pro and NB2 Model
notes: The output socket lets the user connect the model node to another node and use the generated picture as reference. If there is more than one picture, send all of them if possible; if not, send only the first one.

title: Research Recraft V4 image-to-image endpoint so it can accept the image socket
notes: Recraft V4 Pro currently uses fal.ai text-to-image, which takes no picture, so it has an image output (#8) but no image input. Find a Recraft endpoint that accepts a reference image, check its options and pricing, then add an image input like NB2 has.

title: Add new node: Close-up
notes: The Close-up node uses a preset prompt to take a close-up picture and gives the user an input field to type the object or part of the picture to close up. Its output socket can connect to a model node like NB2 or Recraft V4.

title: Add new node: Skin
notes: The Skin node takes an image as input and gives the user a list of options to modify the model's skin by colour, age and spots. It has two outputs (the prompt and the image) that can connect the Skin node to a generation model like NB2.

title: Total amount spent
notes: The feature will sum and display all costs from all the models used by the user during their work. Built: Total badge next to Gallery (CostPanel.js) with per-model breakdown and two-click Reset; all-time total saved in localStorage via addSpent(amount, model); Camera Move ($0.03 per picture) and Claude costs now counted too.

title: Model Polas Node
notes: The node creates, from a given model image connected via input pin, simple natural pictures of the model. The pictures to create are: one picture that shows the entire model with only an intimate tight black outfit (a simple bra and underpants), one picture that shows the frontal face closeup (the model has no makeup and the hair is not styled), one picture that shows a side face closeup of the model (the model has no makeup and the hair is not styled), one picture that shows the entire back side of the model and one picture that shows the entire side of the model.

title: Add View prompt button to all model nodes
notes: I want to get a read-only preview of the prompt that is going to be sent to the model to generate a picture. Built: View prompt button (last button) on NB2, Recraft V4 Pro, Qwen Multi-Angle, Camera Move and Model Polas opens a read-only pop-up (PromptPreviewModal.js) with the exact text Generate sends.

title: Add option to select the model type for Model Polas
notes: I want the user to be able to select which model to use to create the pictures.

title: Add gender selection to Model Polas node
notes: The user must specify whether the person in the reference picture is female or male, so the model shows the right swimwear.

title: Add new node: Head Hair
notes: The node contains options for hair style, colour and length. Provide a pre-selected list of choices for each option. Built: HeadHairNode.js (search "HeadHair") with Style, Colour and Length dropdowns; builds a hair-only edit prompt that protects face, skin, eyebrows and outfit; passes the picture through like Skin.

title: Update Model Polas node prompts for consistent framing
notes: I would like more consistency for the side full-body, front portrait and side portrait polas. Right now each run generates slightly different camera framing. Fixed: two shared camera set-ups (full body / portrait), exact pose angles with both profiles facing left, 3:4 default shape; Face side wording reworded after a fal.ai 422 content-checker refusal.

title: Add new node: Try-on
notes: The node has two inputs: one to connect a node with one or more images of the character, and one to connect a node with one or more images of the clothes to try on.
